category_edits.rationale: Blend each recurrent state with its causal, recency-weighted prefix pool: 0.8*h_t + 0.2*pool_t, using the existing five-step half-life. This preserves recent intent while smoothing the readout. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so training and inference remain consistent without changing the backbone, scoring, loss, or optimizer.

change_summary: Apply the causal 80% current-state / 20% recency-pool readout to all four category models, retaining one checkpoint per category.
